anchor.semantic_hook: Giving something to talk about becomes a gift pedestal that delivers a speaking trumpet to a conversation table.
anchor.setting: A multipurpose civic hall contains an office table, classroom desks, a screening alcove, a meeting table, a salon mirror, and a model street. At the center, an enormous open gift box holds a room-sized speaking trumpet aimed toward two conversation chairs. All other furnishings are ordinary.
anchor.absurd_element: a room-sized speaking trumpet emerging from a gift box

anchor.semantic_hook: Treading one's path becomes placing each foot on a personal trail that forms beneath the walker.

anchor.absurd_element: a cobblestone path weaving and unweaving itself beneath the walker

inserts.action: turns away from two older pairs of footprints entering the family doorway and steps firmly onto a fresh branch of his own path

variations.scene_adjust: two established trails of older footprints enter the family doorway, while a clean untrodden branch begins beside them

anchor.semantic_hook: Being unable to leave off an action becomes an exit that continually returns the person to the action platform.

anchor.semantic_hook: Going from one extreme to the other becomes crossing between two farthest end platforms with no resting place between them.
anchor.setting: A long multipurpose hall has two sharply separated end platforms and an unused neutral floor between them. At the center, a room-sized armored vehicle is made entirely from soft cushions. The rest of the courtyard is practical and calm.

inserts.action: finishes the last task at the desk, hangs up his work bag, and sinks peacefully into the sofa with relaxed shoulders

variations.scene_adjust: a closed work case, house key, slippers, and steaming mug connect the desk to the sofa

variations.scene_adjust: neatly completed folders, a simple tool kit, and an untouched helmet rest near the work desk
